note: Nearly 40, San Francisco, 85 kg at 181 cm, running 12-13 years, kids in elementary school, and explicitly able to afford a five-figure home gym — 'it's a big investment, which, you know, I can afford'. Health is the neglected corner (no strength training since ~2012) and he wants good-to-great, not rescue. He misses 'successful' only in the narrow sense the ICP states it: he is a desk professional, not a business owner or physician. The instructive part is that he fits the profile on paper and still refused, because the stated ICP screens for capacity to pay and this prospect had capacity but no reason to believe the price was justified — a criterion the ICP does not contain.
